answer:
Done — I turned your Strength note into a Page app.

It now:
- Walks through the 4-week program day by day.
- Starts from 12 October.
- Lets you tick off each set.
- Tracks overall and daily progress.
- Keeps the program and progress in the app’s data, not in the note text.

I left the note’s markdown unchanged.
